prompt_en:
Photorealistic vertical compact-camera photograph in a quiet greenhouse seed-library aisle during a storm. Treat Image 1 solely as a visible adult appearance reference. Show one clearly adult woman with long dark wavy hair, natural hair and skin texture, and adult facial proportions informed only by that reference. She holds a broad pressed fern in visible hand contact across both eyes and the bridge of her nose. The fern crosses both eyes and the nose bridge in one continuous sharp overlap while cheek edges, jaw, lips, hairline, hands, clothing, posture, and body orientation remain visible around it; the occlusion is deliberate rather than a missed crop or blur. Her other hand slides a blank seed envelope only partway into an open wooden specimen drawer, suspended between fingers and drawer mouth.

One clearly adult subject remains readable through hair posture hands clothing and body orientation inside the greenhouse aisle. The eye-and-nose identity-bearing region is deliberately covered or turned away while some surrounding head structure remains visible around the fern. A scene-bound hand prop hair curtain or head turn has visible overlap contact or directional cause through the held pressed fern. One concrete unfinished action and one identifiable setting carry the image's mood through the open drawer and seed-library aisle. Accidental crop missed focus motion blur empty scene or full silhouette alone does not substitute for the physically overlapping greenhouse prop.

Fogged panes, storm rain, hanging leaves, damp wood grain, and shallow drawers establish the greenhouse library. Cool blue window light and one warm shelf lamp share falloff across the cuff, fern fibers, drawer edge, and glass. A fern-edge contact shadow and finger pressure make the prop physical. Use medium-close environmental framing: face-and-fern first, envelope-and-drawer midpoint second, greenhouse third.

Lightweight pale fabric, relaxed shoulders and wrists, open aisle space, lifted midtones, gentle contrast, and restrained cream-pink color create a clear serene, airy delicate, softly milky finish while preserving pores, hair strands, fern veins, fabric weave, and wood texture. Off-center framing, compact-camera grain, and one clipped hanging leaf make this feel like a single imperfect everyday photodump member. The observable scene carries broad adult nostalgia through weather, material traces, and the interrupted filing gesture.
